clips.send: Start with something real: one coin. Its face is a circle of radius r , so the face has area pi r squared . A thin layer like this has volume about (area of the face) times (thickness).
clips.text: Start with something real: one coin. Its face is a circle of radius r , so the face has area pi r squared . A thin layer like this has volume ≈ (area of the face) × (thickness).

clips.send: Fill the sphere with water and pour it into the empty cylinder: it fills two thirds. The cone fills the last third. Cone : sphere : cylinder equals 1 : 2 : 3, as Archimedes discovered over 2000 years ago.
clips.text: Fill the sphere with water and pour it into the empty cylinder: it fills two thirds. The cone fills the last third. Cone : sphere : cylinder = 1 : 2 : 3, as Archimedes discovered over 2000 years ago.

clips.send: Now stack 12 identical coins. Every layer has the same area pi r squared , and the layers pile up to a height h . So the volume of the stack is (area of one layer) times (height).
clips.text: Now stack 12 identical coins. Every layer has the same area pi r squared , and the layers pile up to a height h . So the volume of the stack is (area of one layer) × (height).

clips.send: Turn that into a formula. The sphere is 2 over 3 of a cylinder with radius r and height 2r : Vsphere equals 2 over 3 times pi r squared times 2r equals 4 over 3 pi r cubed
clips.text: Turn that into a formula. The sphere is 23 of a cylinder with radius r and height 2r : V sphere equals 23 times pi r squared times 2r equals 43 pi r cubed

clips.send: So a cone holds one third of the cylinder with the same base and height: Vcone equals 1 over 3 pi r squared h (A pyramid is one third of its prism for the same reason.)
clips.text: So a cone holds one third of the cylinder with the same base and height: V cone equals 13 pi r squared h (A pyramid is one third of its prism for the same reason.)

clips.send: Try it with r equals 3 cm and h equals 6 cm. Cylinder: 54 pi is about 169.6 cubic centimeters . Cone: 18 pi is about 56.5 cubic centimeters . Sphere: 36 pi is about 113.1 cubic centimeters . And 18 pi plus 36 pi equals 54 pi , just as the water showed.

clips.send: Now a ball (a sphere) of radius r . Our cylinder is exactly 2r tall, so the ball fits perfectly inside: it touches the bottom, the top and the sides.

clips.send: Push the stack so it leans: still the same coins, so the volume does not change. Now make the layers thinner and thinner, and the stack becomes a smooth cylinder: Vcyl equals pi r squared h

clips.send: Common mix-up: The formulas use the radius r, not the diameter (a 10 cm diameter means r equals 5 cm). The height h of a cone is the straight-up height from the tip to the base, not the slanted length along its side.

clips.send: 从身边的东西开始：一枚硬币。它的表面是半径为 r 的圆，面积是 派 r的平方 。像这样薄薄的一层，体积 约等于 底面积 乘 厚度。
clips.text: 从身边的东西开始：一枚硬币。它的表面是半径为 r 的圆，面积是 π r的平方 。像这样薄薄的一层，体积 ≈ 底面积 × 厚度。

clips.send: 把 12 枚一样的硬币摞起来。每一层的面积都是 派 r的平方 ，一层层叠到高度 h 。所以这摞硬币的体积 等于 每一层的面积 乘 高。
clips.text: 把 12 枚一样的硬币摞起来。每一层的面积都是 π r的平方 ，一层层叠到高度 h 。所以这摞硬币的体积 = 每一层的面积 × 高。

clips.send: 所以圆锥的体积是等底等高圆柱的三分之一： V锥 等于 3分之1 派 r的平方 h （棱锥是等底等高棱柱的三分之一，道理相同。）
clips.text: 所以圆锥的体积是等底等高圆柱的三分之一： V 锥 等于 13 π r的平方 h （棱锥是等底等高棱柱的三分之一，道理相同。）
